title: Workday to Buy Honeydew So AI Agents Agree on the Numbers
dek: A semantic layer deal to give every AI agent the same business definitions.

facts.label: Deal announced at Workday Rising EMEA
Expected close, end of fiscal Q4 2027

caption:
Ask a dashboard, a chatbot and an AI agent for your headcount and you might get three different answers. Workday wants to fix that. 🤖

Workday plans to acquire Honeydew, a startup building a semantic layer for AI and business intelligence. Honeydew's "semantic compiler" will plug into Workday Data Cloud, turning business definitions into exact, governed database queries so agents stop improvising the math behind payroll or revenue.

The pitch: more consistent answers, fewer tokens per prompt, lower costs, and permissions that block unauthorized requests before any query runs. Terms weren't disclosed and the deal is expected to close by January 31, 2027.

We're tracking how enterprise AI is getting tighter on governance at AI Parabellum. Would you trust an AI agent with your payroll numbers?
